description: The configuration surface of the agent chart. GENERATED from values.yaml by `./build.sh Charts` and diffed in CI — docs/plan/03 § charts/. Edit values.yaml, never this file. Members carrying `x-cybercloud-api: false` are chart or platform plumbing and are not part of the resource body.

heartbeatSeconds.description: How often the agent reports in until the platform's welcome says — the welcome carries the resource's own heartbeatSeconds, the same value the install command sets here, and the agent adopts it on every connection. The platform calls a cluster Degraded after ninety seconds without a heartbeat, so a value above thirty leaves fewer than three chances for a packet to arrive.

maxReconnectSeconds.description: The longest the agent waits between dial attempts. It starts at one second and doubles up to this.

cluster.description: Which connected cluster this agent is.

credentialSecretName.description: The Secret, in the release namespace, the agent stores its credential in. The Role in rbac.yaml grants the agent that Secret and no other.

enrollmentToken.description: The one-time token from listInstallCommand. It admits exactly one connection; the agent exchanges it for a credential it keeps in a Secret and never needs the token again. Leave it empty on a later upgrade — an agent that already holds its credential ignores it.

id.description: The connected-cluster resource's id, in 8-4-4-4-12 form, from the install command. The platform binds the tunnel to it at the gateway, so an agent presenting another cluster's id with this cluster's credential is refused.

reference.description: The image to run. ⚠ By digest in any real deployment — docs/plan/18 § Platform security, "a pinned digest, never a tag" — which is what the install command passes when the platform has one. The default is a tag so that a development install has something to pull.

nameOverride.description: Replace the generated object-name stem. Empty means derive it from the release name.
nameOverride.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Helm plumbing. Nothing about it belongs in a resource body.

tunnelEndpoint.description: The WebSocket URL of the platform's gateway — wss://{gateway}/agent/v1/tunnel. The cluster needs outbound HTTPS to it and nothing inbound; the install command fills it in.

resources.description: What the one agent pod requests and is limited to.

cpu.description: CPU, as a Kubernetes quantity. The agent relays frames and runs one API call per request; it is idle between reconciles.

title: agent chart values
